guide.title: Brightwing's Overview
guide.text:
Brightwing is a ranged Healer with strong global presence. She is capable
of continually healing nearby allies without using Mana and protect them against enemy
crowd control effects, due to her Soothing Mist Trait. Her
ability to teleport to an allied Hero across the entire map makes Brightwing a
very mobile Hero that excels on large battlegrounds, like Cursed Hollow.

guide.title: Brightwing's Strengths and Weaknesses
guide.text:
Strengths
Great split-pushing potential
Soothing Mist does not require any Mana
Strong disengage thanks to Emerald Wind
Reliable crowd control with Polymorph
Built-in Cleanse that breaks Stuns, Slows, Roots, and Silences every 75 seconds
Allows a variety of talent builds depending on the game situation
Weaknesses
Cannot use a mount
Requires a lot of map awareness
Her burst or sustained healing takes time or channeling to be applied
Fairly high skill cap compared to other Healers
Requires good positioning

guide.title: Brightwing's Synergies and Counters
guide.text:
Brightwing synergizes with
Since Brightwing's Phase Shift heals based on the target's
maximum Health, she is excellent with high-health Heroes, like Diablo, Stitches,
or Cho. Furthermore, through her global mobility she provides good support for dives,
being a good pick with Heroes that excel at that, like Genji or Tracer.
Brightwing is countered by
Brightwing gets countered by crowd control
heavy Tanks that cannot have their engages
canceled by Polymorph, such as
Anub'arak, Johanna, or E.T.C..

guide.title: Brightwing's Maps
guide.text:
Brightwing's stronger maps
Brightwing's average maps
Brightwing's weaker maps
Brightwing does particularly well on larger Maps like Towers of Doom or Warhead Junction, on which she can
use her global mobility to great effect. On rotation-heavy maps like Tomb of the Spider Queen,
Brightwing's inability to use a mount can often slow her down, making her a liability against aggressive pushing compositions.

guide.title: Brightwing's Tips and Tricks
guide.text:
Phase Shift allows Brightwing to split-soak experience very efficiently while also allowing her to join team fights in time.
Blink Heal can be used to juke enemy Heroes and abilities.
Arcane Flare's casting range is larger than the shooting range of enemy Towers, Forts, and Keeps. Always follow Polymorph with it; the slow can guarantee the hit.
Pixie Dust becomes a crucial ability against Assassins like Jaina or Kael'thas to reduce their spell damage potential. Considering Pixie Dust's low cooldown, it is recommended to use it to mitigate spell damage at the start of the fight, because you will still have it available at the end.
Against dive heroes like Zeratul or Genji, hold Polymorph until they dive towards an ally, since it will greatly reduce their effectiveness. However, it can also be used to guarantee kills of tanks with mobility, like on Muradin before he jumps out or on Anub'arak before he uses Burrow Charge to flee.
Even though Soothing Mist's range relatively small, try to not be very close to your teammates to heal them. Always stay in a position in which the target you want to heal is close to the edge of your healing range, so you do not get damaged or controlled with them.
See our Abilities page for further information »

guide.title: Brightwing's Role in the Current Meta
guide.text:
Brightwing is the only Healer that is capable of joining a team fight
from any location on the battlefield, thanks to Phase Shift.
This allows Brightwing to separate herself from the rest of her team and
soak more Experience in lane than any other Healer.
What also makes Brightwing stand out are her unique healing
mechanics. Brightwing does not actively heal her allies with Abilities. Instead,
Soothing Mist heals nearby teammates for a small amount
every four seconds. In terms of crowd control, Polymorph
poses a serious threat to enemy Heroes, especially on Heroes
that rely on their mobility (such as Zeratul)
to stay alive while dealing damage.
Combined with the Critterize
Talent at Level 16, Polymorph allows your team to
focus fire a single target very efficiently.
Because of her strong Talent Tree, Brightwing's power level increases the
longer the game lasts. This makes her a particularly valuable pick on larger
Maps like Cursed Hollow, Sky Temple, or Dragon Shire.
The correct usage of your mobility
and crowd control Abilities
enables you to heavily influence the outcome of a game, which makes Brightwing
a force to be reckoned with.

abilities.title: Brightwing's Tips and Tricks
abilities.text:
Phase Shift allows Brightwing to split-soak experience very efficiently while also allowing her to join team fights in time.
Blink Heal can be used to juke enemy Heroes and abilities.
Arcane Flare's casting range is larger than the shooting range of enemy Towers, Forts, and Keeps. Always follow Polymorph with it; the slow can guarantee the hit.
Pixie Dust becomes a crucial ability against Assassins like Jaina or Kael'thas to reduce their spell damage potential. Considering Pixie Dust's low cooldown, it is recommended to use it to mitigate spell damage at the start of the fight, because you will still have it available at the end.
Against dive heroes like Zeratul or Genji, hold Polymorph until they dive towards an ally, since it will greatly reduce their effectiveness. However, it can also be used to guarantee kills of tanks with mobility, like on Muradin before he jumps out or on Anub'arak before he uses Burrow Charge to flee.
Even though Soothing Mist's range relatively small, try to not be very close to your teammates to heal them. Always stay in a position in which the target you want to heal is close to the edge of your healing range, so you do not get damaged or controlled with them.

abilities.title: Phase Shift
abilities.text:
Phase Shift
(Z)
Brightwing
Cooldown: 40 seconds
After 2 seconds, teleport to an allied Hero and heal them for 25% of their maximum Health.
Phase Shift is one of the reasons why Brightwing
is considered to be a very impactful Healer when it comes to
soaking Experience and applying global pressure on the opposing team. Brightwing
excels at drawing the attention of at least one enemy Hero to herself while she
is clearing and soaking in lane, only to appear at her
team's side a few seconds later in order to contest an Objective. This will
often result in your own team outnumbering the enemy by one or two players, since
most Heroes cannot keep up with the speed of Brightwing's teleport
via Phase Shift. However, the
tactical advantage of Brightwing being able to globally reunite herself with the
rest of her team comes at the cost of not being able to use a Mount. Make sure
to always keep an eye on your Phase Shift's cooldown.
If it is still recharging, you want to stay close to your team, because without
the possibility to mount up, Brightwing's movement across the battlefield is very
slow. In general, you should only separate yourself from the rest
of your team if Phase Shift is ready to be used.

abilities.title: Arcane Flare
abilities.text:
Arcane Flare
(Q)
Brightwing
Mana: 35
Cooldown: 6 seconds
Shoot a flare dealing 75 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit, and an additional 105 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in the center. If a Hero is hit by the center, Soothing Mist's passive healing instantly activates.
Arcane Flare is a very tricky Ability that may require some experience to be
used efficiently. The projectile of Arcane Flare moves at a moderate speed, which is why
you always have to consider your target's movement, and cast it slightly ahead of
your target's path. Against immovable objects like Structures, however,
Arcane Flare provides a solid sieging tool that is capable of damaging Structures
from afar. It is worth mentioning that the casting range of Arcane Flare is greater
than the range of Forts and Towers, so feel free to attack enemy Structures even
without having allied Minions to tank them for you.

abilities.title: Polymorph
abilities.text:
Polymorph
(W)
Brightwing
Mana: 50
Cooldown: 12 seconds
Polymorph a target for 1.5 seconds, Slowing their Movement Speed by 30% and Silencing them. Targets are not able to attack while Polymorphed.
There are very few Abilities in the game that counter mobile enemy Heroes better
than Polymorph. Being able to completely shut down
a hostile Hero's damage and playmaking potential for a short period of time can single-handedly decide
the outcome of a team fight. Polymorph is a very versatile skill: not only does
it prevent dangerous Assassins from wreaking havoc in your team's ranks, it can
also be used to focus fire enemy Tanks. In the case of durable Heroes, it is done
with the help of Critterize at Level 16, which allows
your team to burst them down before the use of defensive Abilities.

abilities.title: Pixie Dust
abilities.text:
Pixie Dust
(E)
Brightwing
Mana: 60
Cooldown: 10 seconds
Increase target Hero's Movement Speed by 20%, and grant them 30 Spell Armor for 3 seconds, reducing Spell damage taken by 30%.
Pixie Dust fulfils two different roles in Brightwing's arsenal.
Firstly, Pixie Dust can be used to protect an allied Hero by increasing its
Movement Speed and blocking Spell Damage. This can be extremely useful
on teammates who find themselves pursued by one or more enemy Heroes. Secondly,
Pixie Dust can be used to increase your own Movement Speed in order to catch up
with the rest of your team more quickly. Keep in mind, however, that you should always make sure to
have this Ability ready when a team fight is about to begin.

abilities.title: Blink Heal
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Blink Heal
(R)
Brightwing
Heroic
Mana: 40
Charges: 2
Recharge Time: 9 seconds
Teleport to a nearby ally. When teleporting to a Hero, heal them for 200 (+4% per level).
Stores up to 2 charges.
Blink Heal instantly teleports Brightwing to a nearby allied Hero, while also
healing it at the same time. This mutual benefit makes Blink Heal an incredibly
versatile Heroic Ability, as it will allow you to reposition yourself and heal
damaged teammates at the same time. However, Blink Heal also has its downsides,
most importantly that its healing amount is quite low compared to other strong
heals like Rehgar's Ancestral Healing which restores a huge
amount of hit points at once. Consequently, Blink Heal should not mainly be used
to heal Warriors in the frontline, but rather to keep your Assassins healthy.
Another reason why you should avoid using Blink Heal
on Tanks, if possible, is the fact that it will always teleport you directly next to your
targeted ally, which could result in Brightwing exposing herself to enemy crowd
control Abilities.
One of the most important qualities as a Brightwing player is to remain calm
and observant during all stages of the game. Blink Heal allows you to escape many
sticky situations which makes a Brightwing a very elusive Hero. Remember that
you can use Blink Heal on allied Minions and Mercenaries. This can be very useful
when you are quickly looking for a safe location to Blink Heal to.

abilities.title: Emerald Wind
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Emerald Wind
(R)
Brightwing
Heroic
Mana: 90
Cooldown: 50 seconds
After 0.5 seconds, create an expanding nova of wind, dealing 225 (+4% per level) damage and pushing enemies away.
Brightwing's second Heroic Ability, Emerald Wind,
is a very effective, yet sometimes situational choice that needs to be used with great
caution. There are several requirements that need to be met before you should
decide to pick Emerald Wind instead of Blink Heal.
Firstly, you should consider if you need a strong disengage Ability to counter
enemy dive Heroes like Genji. If the
opposing team consists of at least two or more aggressive frontliners, Emerald Wind
may indeed become a useful tool to keep them at bay. Secondly, you need to
double-check whether your team has another Support
or Healer in its lineup. Heroes like
Medivh or Zarya can greatly assist Brightwing in keeping her teammates alive,
which makes Emerald Wind a valid alternative to Blink Heal.

abilities.title: Soothing Mist
abilities.text:
Soothing Mist
(D)
Brightwing
Cooldown: 75 seconds
Activate to remove all Stun, Root, Slow, and Silence effects from nearby allied Heroes.
Passive: Brightwing heals nearby allied Heroes for 110 (+4% per level) every 4 seconds
Soothing Mist is a very useful passive trait that does not require any Mana.
This makes Brightwing an exceptionally stable laner during the early
stages of the game, as she can continuously bully her laning
opponent with the help of Arcane Flare and her Basic
Attacks, while at the same time sustaining herself with Soothing Mist. Soothing Mist's activatable component
cures nearby allied Heroes from Stuns, Slows,
Roots, and Silences. However,
keep in mind that the cleansing effect
travels in a pulse around Brightwing, so precise timing is of the essence.
It is worth mentioning that Soothing Mist only triggers if there is at least
one injured target in its radius (including Brightwing herself). If Soothing Mist is inactive in this way, it
will trigger instantly when an injured target enters the radius (or if an existing
target takes damage). Always keep an eye on the cooldown of Soothing Mist, and
make sure to be close to your allies when it is due to trigger, even if they are
only slightly injured.

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
Greater Polymorph could perhaps be considered if the enemy
team composition runs dangerous Melee Assassins like Illidan
or The Butcher that need to be shut down for as long as possible.
And even then, the extra healing and cooldown reduction coming from Hyper Shift proves
to be more useful throughout the game.
Pixie Charm is only worth playing on Maps with a lot of Mercenary
Camps that are also relatively safely to access, like Garden of Terror,
Dragon Shire, or Sky Temple. Thanks to it, you will be able to
help your team keep the macro pressure up.
Hyper Shift allows Brightwing to teleport across
the battlefield a lot more frequently by staying close to dying Minions.
This proves to be especially useful on larger Maps like
Cursed Hollow or Garden of Terror,
as Brightwing is able to split-push more efficiently if she has her
Phase Shift available allowing her to assist her teammates if need be. This Talent
has great synergy with Peekaboo! at Level 7, which will
add a Shield and additional vision whenever Brightwing
uses Phase Shift on a friendly Hero.

team needs extra crowd control to secure the kill on the
Polymorphed enemy.
Magic Spit increases Brightwing's Attack Range,
which allows her to stay away from enemy Heroes
more easily. The additional cooldown reduction on her Trait is a great extra to have.
This Talent has great synergy with Critical Mist.

talent_pages.text:
Sticky Flare should mainly be considered if your
team is lacking crowd control in general. Unlike other Talents related to
Arcane Flare, Sticky Flare's Slow effect is a useful
tool that allows you to Slow several enemies at the same time, which can aid you
in many different situations.
Peekaboo! works very well if you chose Hyper Shift
at Level 1. Being able to reveal Stealthed enemies like Nova
or Zeratul in a large radius around
your selected ally can thwart the enemy team's plans of initiating a team fight
and turn the momentum in your favour. The additional Shield applied on the target
is the icing on the cake that makes this Talent a very solid choice.
Critical Mist will be an excellent option in most games.
Even if the opposing team has no Stuns or Roots,
it can be used to cleanse a Slow and provide great healing
for your teammates. It should always be paired with Magic Spit.

talent_pages.title: Level 10 Talents for Brightwing
talent_pages.text:
✓
Blink Heal
(Level 10)
Brightwing
Mana: 40
Charges: 2
Recharge Time: 9 seconds
Teleport to a nearby ally. When teleporting to a Hero, heal them for 200 (+4% per level).
Stores up to 2 charges.
?
Emerald Wind
(Level 10)
Brightwing
Mana: 90
Cooldown: 50 seconds
After 0.5 seconds, create an expanding nova of wind, dealing 225 (+4% per level) damage and pushing enemies away.

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
In this section we discuss when and why to pick a given Heroic Ability.
If you want to read how they work in detail and/or you are looking for some tips on how to use them,
check them out on the Abilities and Strategy page.
Blink Heal enables Brightwing to
teleport to allies over short distances, which allows her to manoeuvre both
defensively and offensively during team fights. Dodging enemy Basic Attacks or
skillshot Abilities like Muradin's Storm Bolt or
Stitches' Hook with the help of Blink Heal allows
your team to turn on the enemy without worrying about the respective crowd
control effects. By the same token, Brightwing is able to use Blink Heal as a
gap-closing Ability by using it on an allied unit to
get in range of an enemy and cast an unexpected
Polymorph on them.
Brightwing's second Heroic Ability, Emerald Wind,
is a very effective, yet situational choice that needs to be used with great
caution. There are several requirements that need to be met before you should
decide to pick Emerald Wind instead of Blink Heal.
Firstly, you should consider if you need a strong disengage Ability to counter
enemy initiators like Tyrael or Anub'arak. If the
opposing team consists of at least two or more aggressive Warriors, Emerald Wind
may indeed become a useful tool to keep them at bay. Secondly, you need to
double-check whether your team has another Support or
Healer in its lineup. Heroes like
Medivh or Zarya can be enough to assist Brightwing in keeping her teammates alive,
which makes Emerald Wind a valid alternative to Blink Heal.

talent_pages.title: Level 13 Talents for Brightwing
talent_pages.text:
?
Pixie Boost
(Level 13)
Brightwing
Increase Pixie Dust's Movement Speed bonus to 50%, decaying to 20% over 3 seconds.
✓
Safety Dust
(Level 13)
Brightwing
Increase Pixie Dust's duration by 1 second. Soothing Mist and Blink Heal heal allies with an active Pixie Dust for 75% more.
?
Pixie Power
(Level 13)
Brightwing
Reduce the cooldown of Pixie Dust by 3 seconds and increase the Spell Armor granted by 25.

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
Pixie Boost's Movement Speed Boost is usually
not strong enough to outperform the extra healing and Spell Armor from the
other Level 13 Talents. However, it can be a good choice alongside Heroes that
greatly benefit from extra Movement Speed, such as Garrosh or Arthas.
Safety Dust provides a great healing boost.
This Talent does not increase Phase Shift's Healing, which
is Brightwing's main source of healing in teamfights. For this reason, we only recommend this
Talent if the opposing team does not have many different Spell Damage
Abilities to be reduced by Pixie Power.
Pixie Power provides an additional Spell Armor
buff to the target of Brightwing's Pixie Dust.
If the enemy team relies on Mages and their Spell Damage,
this Talent becomes a great choice.

talent_pages.title: Level 16 Talents for Brightwing
talent_pages.text:
?
Hush!
(Level 16)
Brightwing
Enemy Heroes hit by the center of Arcane Flare are Silenced for 1 second and deal 25% less damage for 3 seconds.
✓
Critterize
(Level 16)
Brightwing
While Polymorphed, the target's Armor is reduced by 25, increasing the damage they take by 25%.
?
Phase Out
(Level 16)
Brightwing
Cooldown: 20 seconds
Activate to place Brightwing in Stasis for 0.75 seconds.

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
Hush! is only recommended if you picked the other Q-related Talents
at Level 4 and 7. Combined, Brightwing turns into a quite potent damage
and crowd control-heavy Hero.
Critterize enables Brightwing's
Polymorph to increase all damage done to a
single enemy Hero by 25% by reducing their Armor,
which will allow your team to burst it down very quickly. Do not
hesitate to make use of Critterize against enemy Tanks to bring them down more quickly.
Phase Out can be a recommended Talent if the enemy team has a lot of
burst damage and crowd control.
The short 20-second cooldown makes it a very forgiving Ability.

talent_pages.title: Level 20 Talents for Brightwing
talent_pages.text:
✓
Invisible Friends
(Level 20)
Brightwing
Blink Heal grants Stealth to Brightwing and her Heroic targets for 9 seconds, and they are Unrevealable for the first 0.5 seconds. While Stealthed by Invisible Friends, Heroes heal for 25 (+4% per level) health per second.
Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.
?
Intensive Winds
(Level 20)
Brightwing
Permanently reduce Emerald Wind's cooldown to 5 seconds.
?
Speedy Dragon
(Level 20)
Brightwing
Permanently gain 20% Movement Speed. Reduce Phase Shift's cast time by 1 second.
?
Faerie Protector
(Level 20)
Brightwing
Cooldown: 45 seconds
Activate to apply Pixie Dust to all nearby Heroes.
Passive: Pixie Dust always bounces back and applies to Brightwing.

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
Invisible Friends provides a Stealth effect on both
Brightwing and the healed target. This makes the Talent a great option for saving
your allies, as it makes them effectively invulnerable to targeted Abilities.
Intensive Winds is an excellent Talent. It allows
Brightwing to always decide when a fight is happening. With a 5-second cooldown, Emerald
Wind can be used several times in the same fight, to either disengage or to
apply high damage and crowd control to the enemy team.
Speedy Dragon increases Brightwing's Movement Speed
by a large margin, which makes her much harder to catch. Despite that, it divides
the cast time of Phase Shift, which is an excellent
improvement for fights. It will always ensure that your ally will be healed before
getting hit by a high burst damage.
Faerie Protector applies a talented instance of
Pixie Dust on all nearby allied Heroes. This is an
excellent Talent against wombo combo compositions.
It is excellent with Safety Dust and
Critical Mist, as it can be used right before a
Soothing Mist activation, providing great heals
for your whole team.
